aiConsentTitle: Your document will be sent to Claude
aiConsentBody:
To answer, the document's content and your questions are sent over an encrypted connection to Anthropic's Claude AI service. Anthropic doesn't use this content to train its models.

Keep this in mind for documents with personal data such as ID numbers, health or bank details.
